title: 62-year-old man feeling dizzy
arrival: A 62-year-old man presents feeling dizzy since this morning.
keyCriterion: Yellow — Circulation: recent fainting (no red criteria)
feedbackWhy: He fainted earlier today. Recent fainting meets a yellow Circulation criterion. No red criterion is met: capillary refill is 3 seconds, which is not more than 3 seconds, and his heart rate is below 150. He should be moved to the clinical treatment area.
reviewNote: CLINICIAN REVIEW REQUIRED: capillary refill of exactly 3 seconds is deliberately just short of the red threshold (>3 sec); confirm this near-miss is acceptable. Confirm that fainting once this morning counts as recent fainting. Every value is proposed.

design.intendedChallenge: Recent fainting is a yellow Circulation criterion. A value just short of a red threshold does not meet the red criterion, so each value has to be compared with the card.
design.expectedCommonError: triaging as red because he fainted and his capillary refill is borderline, or as green because he is alert.

airway_red.text: Speaks in full sentences. No stridor. No respiratory distress. No central cyanosis.

circulation_red.text: Pulse felt at the wrist. Capillary refill 3 seconds. No bleeding.

disability_red.text: No convulsions. Alert with normal mental status. No headache. No stiff neck.

other_red.text: Age 62. No chest or abdominal pain. No trauma, poisoning, threatened limb or snake bite. Not aggressive.

airway_yellow.text: No swelling of the mouth, throat or neck. No wheezing.

circulation_yellow.text: Fainted once this morning and recovered within a minute. Not pale. No vomiting or diarrhoea. No ongoing bleeding. Drinking normally.

disability_yellow.text: Alert and calm. No weakness. No visual disturbance. No pain.

other_yellow.text: No rash, deformity, fracture or dislocation. No trauma. No known surgical diagnosis. Passing urine normally. No bite or needlestick exposure.
